metadata.technology_specification: Roller Compactor for powder and granule size reduction
metadata.technology_reasoning: Roller compactors with twin or single smooth or toothed rollers are the industry standard for dry granulation in pharmaceuticals and chemicals due to their efficiency in producing compacted ribbons for milling and controlled density granules. They dominate dry granulation processes because they avoid using liquids, suitable for moisture sensitive materials.

components.reasoning: Rollers are the core functional elements that perform the compaction, always procured as precision-machined components and essential for roller compaction.
The feeding system regulates powder flow into the rollers, typically composed of a hopper and controlled feed screw or paddle feeder, standard and sourced as subassemblies.
Provides mechanical power and torque to rotate the rollers, a critical separate component with dedicated suppliers.
Commonly used to transmit power from motor to rollers or other moving parts, usually procured separately but occasionally integrated into motor assemblies.
Conveys the compacted ribbon product away from rollers, often includes scraper, chute, or conveyor belts, typically modular subsystems.
Electronic controls for operation parameters and automation, usually a standalone module sourced from specialized suppliers.
The structural framework supporting components, built as a separate welded or machined assembly, standard in all roller compactor designs.

Rollers (Smooth or Toothed).name: Steel Ingots
Rollers (Smooth or Toothed).reasoning: Primary raw material processed into steel for rollers due to high strength and wear resistance, essential for mechanical durability.

Rollers (Smooth or Toothed).name: Titanium
Rollers (Smooth or Toothed).reasoning: Used in some high-performance rollers for corrosion resistance and strength; less common and can be substituted by steel or tool steel.

Rollers (Smooth or Toothed).name: Tool steel
Rollers (Smooth or Toothed).reasoning: Commonly used for toothed rollers due to wear resistance and toughness, standard industry choice.

Rollers (Smooth or Toothed).name: Titanium carbide
Rollers (Smooth or Toothed).reasoning: Used as surface treatment or coating to enhance hardness and wear resistance on rollers; alternatives exist such as chromium coatings.

Feeding System (Hopper and Feed Screw).name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Feeding System (Hopper and Feed Screw).reasoning: Corrosion-resistant and food-safe material used for hoppers and feed screws in industry standard designs.

Feeding System (Hopper and Feed Screw).name: Steel Ingots
Feeding System (Hopper and Feed Screw).reasoning: Primary raw input for manufacturing structural feeding components where corrosion resistance is not critical.

Feeding System (Hopper and Feed Screw).name: Aluminum
Feeding System (Hopper and Feed Screw).reasoning: Used for lightweight hopper structures; corrosion resistance moderate, can be alternative in some designs.

Feeding System (Hopper and Feed Screw).name: Polyethylene
Feeding System (Hopper and Feed Screw).reasoning: Used for liners or parts of hopper or feed screw to reduce material adhesion; optional depending on design.

Drive Motor and Gearbox Assembly.name: Steel Ingots
Drive Motor and Gearbox Assembly.reasoning: Primary raw material for gears and shafts inside the gearbox for strength and durability.

Drive Motor and Gearbox Assembly.name: Copper
Drive Motor and Gearbox Assembly.reasoning: Essential for motor windings due to excellent electrical conductivity, mandatory for motor function.

Drive Motor and Gearbox Assembly.name: Aluminum
Drive Motor and Gearbox Assembly.reasoning: Used for motor housing and some gearbox components to reduce weight while maintaining strength.

Drive Motor and Gearbox Assembly.name: Tool steel
Drive Motor and Gearbox Assembly.reasoning: Used for gears requiring wear resistance in the gearbox, standard choice.

Belt or Chain Drive System.name: Steel Ingots
Belt or Chain Drive System.reasoning: Base material for chain links and sprockets for strength and fatigue resistance.

Belt or Chain Drive System.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Belt or Chain Drive System.reasoning: Used where corrosion resistance is required, especially for chains and sprockets in harsh environments.

Belt or Chain Drive System.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Belt or Chain Drive System.reasoning: Used in belts as a base polymer due to strength and wear resistance; alternative polymers may be used.

Compacted Ribbon Discharge System.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Compacted Ribbon Discharge System.reasoning: Primary material for discharge chutes and surfaces contacting product, corrosion resistant and sanitary.

Compacted Ribbon Discharge System.name: Aluminum
Compacted Ribbon Discharge System.reasoning: Used for structural frames or parts where lower weight is required; less corrosion resistant than stainless steel.

Compacted Ribbon Discharge System.name: Tool steel
Compacted Ribbon Discharge System.reasoning: Possible use in wear surfaces and tooling parts; standard but alternatives exist.

Control Panel and PLC System.name: Copper
Control Panel and PLC System.reasoning: Essential for electrical wiring and PCB traces due to excellent conductivity and low cost.

Control Panel and PLC System.name: Aluminum
Control Panel and PLC System.reasoning: Used for enclosure chassis due to lightweight and corrosion resistance; alternatives exist.

Control Panel and PLC System.name: Silicon
Control Panel and PLC System.reasoning: Fundamental semiconductor material for PLC and control electronics, absolutely essential.

Control Panel and PLC System.name: Polycarbonate
Control Panel and PLC System.reasoning: Common polymer for control panel transparent windows or housings; alternatives exist.

Frame / Structural Chassis.name: Steel Ingots
Frame / Structural Chassis.reasoning: Primary raw material processed into structural steel for frame due to strength and cost effectiveness.

Frame / Structural Chassis.name: Aluminum
Frame / Structural Chassis.reasoning: Used in lighter frame designs for weight reduction, standard alternative to steel.

Frame / Structural Chassis.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Frame / Structural Chassis.reasoning: Used for corrosion resistance in frames exposed to harsh environments; more costly alternative.
